svg.title: Inside AvenHook.beforeSwap
svg.desc: Steps of one beforeSwap call: read pool price and top-of-block, read oracle and mark with a gas cap, fall back on a bad read, compute gap, direction, premium and stress, clamp, persist, emit, return the fee with the override flag.
svg.text: Inside beforeSwap · how one fee is computed
Integer-only, never reverts on a bad read, identical in Solidity and TypeScript. Defaults shown: base 0.05%, cap 1%, fallback 0.30%.
